verification.docs: 92 pages; zero undocumented elements; six live interactions per engine
verification.native: 34 Chromium and 33 Firefox/WebKit checks in source and compiled definitions
verification.contrast: Both variants pass >=4.5:1 text and >=3:1 selected-indicator boundaries in light/dark across all engines

implementation: One TanStack selected value and one-time first-enabled initialization; no child selected/tooltip/secondary aliases.
Native tab buttons, actual tablist and panel ElementInternals roles; panel labels refer to the public Tab host for cross-engine scope support. Native controls references resolve matching panel hosts.
Automatic/manual focus activation, Home/End, disabled/hidden navigation, RTL and one roving entry; nested values do not bubble as outer tab changes.

Primary geometry keeps the source 50px tab control and 24px gap, with the selected Material 3px indicator, 24px minimum length and 2px label inset. Panel separation retains 12px. Vertical placement is the approved logical-start house adaptation.
Inset composes the real Group, shared indicator and verified gray fill/outline treatment.

Ordinary children remain in place, hidden/inert when inactive. One inert HTML template or a pure renderContent callback supports lazyMount/unmountOnExit through a component-owned light-DOM container. Native surrounding form association is retained.
The indicator canvas uses the complete intrinsic scrolling width; viewport clipping must not shorten that canvas. Scroll offsets round outward to reveal fractional edges in WebKit.
limits: M22 must implement React-owned child reconciliation and mount control using the canonical panel state; this native Lit/HTML renderer is not that React acceptance.
Actual speech output and final integrated browser/package checks remain M26.

failuresFixed: The scrolling indicator canvas initially matched the viewport width instead of the full intrinsic tab content.
WebKit rounded a fractional scroll delta and left a 0.65625px trailing edge; outward rounding reveals the complete edge.
A newly created native tab target did not invalidate the root renderer after initial selection. Explicit part notifications now schedule that update, and startup paint has a regression check.
